text:
tariq: Post-call capture: vendor roadmap update was messy. Key points: H100 microcode validation still outstanding, MI300 cross-region cert needs extra paperwork for APAC marketplace, Gaudi driver v2 RC landed but ABI notes unclear. Need a coordinated onramp plan for marketplace + SI + legal.
claire: For marketplace listing we require final image hash + driver id 10 calendar days prior. Also need a signed attestation from vendor for microcode changes if we advertise performance gains.
sanjay: Perf team saw 3% token dropout on H100 at high concurrency when microcode hotfix applied. Repro snippet: `grpc_bench --model=h100-rtx --concurrency=64 --seq=2048`. Raising concern for public benchmarks.
molly: Ops: if H100 GA slips beyond 2024-08-08, propose we move to a staged partner-only rollout first, then full public announcement once vendor certs the microcode. This minimizes churn for customers.
partner-bot: Vendor feed summary: H100 microcode validation extended by 10 days; MI300 cross-region compliance docs need signatures by 2024-07-21; Gaudi driver v2 RC published 2024-07-12 (link: https://vendor.example/notes/3633).
tariq: action items (owners):
- vendor attestation / microcode confirmation (CLAIRE) due 2024-07-15
- MI300 compliance doc sign-off (SANJAY + LEGAL) due 2024-07-21
- SI rebuild window for Gaudi (MOLLY) target 2024-07-18 -> 2024-07-24
- staging rollout plan if H100 delayed (TARIQ) due 2024-07-16
claire: Marketing/PR note: embargo lead time needed = 9 business days for a co-announcement. If we target public announce 2024-08-12, we must freeze messaging by 2024-08-01.
sanjay: Certification note: APAC regions require additional data residency checks for Private deployments, add +3 business days. We'll flag this on the gating checklist.
molly: SI ops: recommend integrator dry-run on a mirrored infra pool to avoid disturbing production. Can reserve slots 2024-07-18/19. Will email integrator leads now.
partner-bot: Reminder: marketplace checksum policy updated 2024-07-10. All published images must include `sha256` metadata and vendor-driver tag.
tariq: fallback plan discussion: map H100 workloads to H200 or B200 quantized variants for latency-sensitive customers. We'll publish explicit route rules (example):
```
route-policy set h100_fallback -> [h200-prod, b200-q8] when p99>200ms or microcode_pending=true
```
claire: Agree. Also add a marketplace note that performance claims are "subject to vendor microcode validation" to avoid false advertising. Legal will draft a short clause.
sanjay: Perf teams will run an extra 24h stability run on H100 once microcode final is provided. If p99 jitter >5% vs baseline, escalate to vendor PM.
molly: Infra: we'll need 48-72h to reallocate Dedicated pool capacity if fallback routing is triggered. Flag oncall and open ticket INF-9202.
tariq: I'll consolidate timeline doc and share in partners drive. Quick tentative timeline in this thread:
- 2024-07-12: Gaudi v2 RC (done)
- 2024-07-15: vendor microcode attestation due
- 2024-07-18: SI dry-run starts (Gaudi)
- 2024-07-21: MI300 compliance sign-off due
- 2024-08-01: messaging freeze for 2024-08-12 public announce
- 2024-08-12: target public announcement (subject to vendor GA)
claire: Cool. I'll chase vendor PMs for the attestation doc and loop legal. Also will coordinate marketing embargo windows.
sanjay: Will post perf logs and any failure spikes. If we see token-drop >1%, immediate alert.
molly: Sending invite to integrator leads for dry-run slots now.
tariq: Thanks, team. We'll reconvene after vendor confirms attestation. If anything changes I'll update thread. :thumbsup:
